title: AI Crayon Drawing Generator
summary: Make crayon drawings with AI: wax crayon illustration, kids' crayon art, crayon resist and scratch art. Describe it, pick a crayon style, and Flick draws it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make a crayon drawing with AI?


Describe the subject, ask for wax crayon with bold layered strokes and name the paper, such as a lighthouse in crayon on cream paper with white flecks of paper showing, then pick a crayon style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the drawing into a clip.


### Can AI make a drawing look like a child drew it?


Yes. Ask for a child's crayon drawing with naive proportions, wobbly outlines and colour going over the lines, on lined notebook or plain printer paper, and keep the subject simple, such as a dragon, a house or a rainbow.


### Can AI turn a photo into a crayon drawing?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for a wax crayon drawing of it with layered strokes and paper texture showing through, keeping the same pose and framing.


### Can I animate a crayon drawing?


Yes. Generate the crayon drawing first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small motion, such as a sleeping cat's tail twitching, while asking to keep the crayon texture.


### Is the crayon drawing generator free?


Yes, it is free to start with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on the free plan. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
